sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
body: When you use OIYO, we may collect usage data — pages visited, time on page, browser type, device type, and referring URL — automatically through Google Analytics 4.
If you email us at support@oiyo.net, we receive your email address and the contents of your message.

The birth details, answers, and other inputs you enter into an assessment or tool are processed in your browser to produce a result. Unless you choose to save or share that result, they are not sent to us.
We do not collect names, passwords, or payment information, and using the site does not require an account.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
body: We use the information to measure traffic and improve the site, to show advertising through Google AdSense, to respond to messages you send us, and to meet legal obligations.
We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: 3. Third Parties and Cookies
body: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how visitors use the site. It collects usage data in aggregate and does not identify you. You can opt out across all sites with the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

We use Google AdSense to display ads. Google and its partners use cookies and similar technologies to serve and measure ads, including ads based on your prior visits to this and other sites. You can turn off personalized advertising in your Google account or through the industry opt-out page. Turning off personalization does not remove ads; it makes them less specific to you.
You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some parts of the site may not work correctly without them.

sections.heading: 4. Data Retention
body: Analytics data is kept according to Google's retention settings (14 months by default). Messages you send us are kept only as long as needed to answer them.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to see the data we hold about you, ask us to delete it, opt out of analytics tracking, and withdraw your consent to cookies.
To make a request, email us at support@oiyo.net.

sections.heading: 6. Children's Privacy
body: OIYO is not directed at children under 14, and we do not knowingly collect information from them. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Email us at support@oiyo.net. The date of the latest change is shown at the top of this page.
